description: This PHP file is a unit test for the InfoArray class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance module, testing methods related to match and parameter arrays.

classes.name: InfoArrayTest
classes.description: A unit test class for verifying the behavior of the InfoArray class, including setup and specific test methods for match and parameter array retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes two InfoArray objects with different strategies used for subsequent test assertions.

methods.name: testGetMatchArray
methods.description: Tests that getMatchArray() returns the expected match criteria from InfoArray instances.

methods.name: testGetParameterArray
methods.description: Verifies that getParameterArray() returns the correct parameters array or null depending on the InfoArray instance.
